name: property-deep-dive
description:
Pre-purchase property due diligence across 103 countries — tax, risks, rental yield, visa, mortgage, building permits, buyer-side agency landscape, transaction-fraud register, foreign-buyer language requirements, broadband + Starlink registry, buyer-nationality home-country tax overlay (FATCA/PFIC/IFI/Modelo 720/T1135/IVIE/Box 3/Olim), foreign-buyer remote-execution mechanisms (POA + RON + e-conveyancing + eIDAS QES + mortgage residual wet-ink), 90-day post-completion relocation logistics (pets + driving licence + vehicle import + utility setup + healthcare gap), international schools + catchment areas (IB / British / American / French Lycée AEFE / German Schule / Nord Anglia / Cognita / GEMS / Inspired / QSI), and 16 other facets per address.

Drop in any address or listing URL: the skill detects the country, loads the local playbook, runs your chosen sections, and outputs a structured Markdown brief.

Sources are primary government registries (cadastres, tax authorities, risk bureaux, telecom regulators), not aggregator sites. Every figure dated. Every section confidence-labelled with a band that decays without re-verification. A regulatory-watch tracker flags reforms before they invalidate the brief.

Try asking:
/property-deep-dive Calle Mayor 5, Madrid --visa --retirement
/property-deep-dive https://rightmove.co.uk/142857 --integrity --journey=pre-offer
/property-deep-dive --compare=fr,it,pt --retirement
/property-deep-dive Athens 10556 --type=heritage --journey=foreign-buyer
/property-deep-dive 12 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris --permits --type=heritage
/property-deep-dive Bali 80361 --language --connectivity --journey=foreign-buyer
/property-deep-dive Lisboa 1100-001 --tax --home-tax --remote --relocation --journey=foreign-buyer
/property-deep-dive Singapore 049145 --schools --digital-nomad --home-tax --journey=foreign-buyer

103 countries fully populated · 38 user-invocable sections · 4 cross-cutting layers.
